statuses.name: burning
statuses.description: Deals extra fire damage when matched

statuses.name: enchanted
statuses.description: Counts as two gems for combo calculation

statuses.name: cursed
statuses.description: Deals damage to the player when matched

statuses.name: transmuted
statuses.description: Element has been changed to a different type

statuses.name: petrified
statuses.description: Cannot be moved and blocks adjacent swaps

statuses.name: shielded
statuses.description: Must be matched twice to clear

statuses.name: charged
statuses.description: Explodes in a cross pattern when matched

statuses.name: linked
statuses.description: Clearing this gem also clears all linked gems

statuses.name: timed
statuses.description: Disappears after a set number of turns if not matched

exclusion_groups.name: movement_block
exclusion_groups.description: Only one movement-blocking status can apply at a time

exclusion_groups.name: element_modify
exclusion_groups.description: Only one element-modifying status can apply at a time
